definitions.gloss: gift; present; gift item for formal occasions
definitions.explanation: A gift exchanged on formal or ceremonial occasions, such as seasonal greetings, weddings, or funerals. More formal than a casual present.

examples.japanese: {贈答品|ぞうとうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{贈答品|ぞうとうひん}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{包装|ほうそう}→包装：11932_housou⟧もして⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: This store also does gift wrapping.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{中元|ちゅうげん}→お中元：06125_ochuugen⟧や⟦お{歳暮|せいぼ}→お歳暮：06126_oseibo⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{贈答品|ぞうとうひん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{熨斗|のし}→熨斗：07133_noshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧だ。
examples.english: It's customary to attach a noshi decoration to seasonal gifts like mid-year and year-end presents.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{贈答|ぞうとう}→贈答：18041_zoutou⟧ (gift-giving/exchange of gifts) + ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (item). Refers specifically to gifts exchanged on formal occasions, as opposed to casual birthday presents or souvenirs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {贈答品|ぞうとうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}る→贈る：09862_okuru⟧: to send a gift
- {贈答品|ぞうとうひん}⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧: gift section (in a department store)
- {贈答品|ぞうとうひん}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧: for gift-giving purposes
- {贈答品|ぞうとうひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{包装|ほうそう}→包装：11932_housou⟧: gift wrapping

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧: present — casual, often for birthdays or personal occasions
- ⟦{贈|おく}り{物|もの}→贈り物：01343_okurimono⟧: gift — general term covering both formal and informal gifts
- ⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧: souvenir — specifically a gift brought back from travel
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{出物|でもの}→引き出物：10656_hikidemono⟧: wedding favor — gifts given to guests at a wedding

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has a strong culture of formal gift-giving. The two main {贈答品|ぞうとうひん} seasons are ⟦お{中元|ちゅうげん}→お中元：06125_ochuugen⟧ (mid-year, around July) and ⟦お{歳暮|せいぼ}→お歳暮：06126_oseibo⟧ (year-end, around December), when people send gifts to business contacts, teachers, doctors, and others they are indebted to. Department stores set up special {贈答品|ぞうとうひん} sections during these seasons.
